_note: The ONE pin map + board geometry for the Wi-Fi paper plane. pages/plane.php draws the pictures and the table from this; plane/arduino/firmware.ino must use the same pins. Units are MILLIMETRES. Boards are stored TOP-DOWN (chip side up, USB/top edge up) - Joe 2026-10-14: 'always top down'. draw_wiring(['flip'=>true]) mirrors it to the pins-toward-you view used while plugging wires in.

measured.xiao: Seeed's official back-view render (wiki XIAO_ESP32-C3_back_pinout.png), 15.8 px/mm: board 17.8 x 21, USB-C 9 wide sticking out 1.45, pin pitch 2.54, first pin 2.84 from the USB edge, pin centres 1.14 in from each side. Top-down order from Seeed's front pinout (re-checked 2026-10-14): left D0-D6, right 5V GND 3V3 D10 D9 D8 D7. Pin NAMES are printed on the BOTTOM only.
measured.drv: WWZMDiB DRV8833 (B0DB8CX8LK, the boat's driver, ordered 2026-09-16). Labels are printed on the side WITHOUT the chip. Label side: left IN4 IN3 GND VCC IN2 IN1, right EEP OUT1 OUT2 OUT3 OUT4 ULT (confirmed from the listing photos 2026-10-14), so chip side up the two rows swap. 6 pins per side at 2.54, rows 15.24 apart; board ~18.5 x 16.5 (estimate, check with a ruler). Headers ship LOOSE - the boat's driver already has them soldered.

airframe._note: The paper plane, in mm. Origin = the nose, x to the RIGHT wing, y back toward the tail. lib/plane.php draws the printable template (true size on Letter) and every build-step picture from these numbers. Keel dart (2026-10-14, Joe: 'missing a center spine'): fold in half along the middle, fold each wing back out along the keel lines, a skewer spine inside the keel. Replaces the flat delta, which had no keel and never flew. Tractor props in front, NOT PowerUp-style rear pushers: with ~6 g of motors at the tail the balance point lands ~30 mm too far back.
airframe._cg: Neutral point ~121 mm from the nose (25% of the 179 mm mean chord, whose leading edge is at 76 mm). CG 100 = ~12% static margin. Weight estimate: 25.3 g before the battery, with the airframe centroid at 166 mm; the 5.5 g battery balances at y ~89, inside its box.
airframe._parts: xiao/drv/battery x are measured from the TOP SEAM of the folded plane (what you see from above). On the flat template lib/plane.php moves them out by 'keel' so nothing lands on the keel strip, which folds underneath; the battery straddles the seam so it prints as two half-boxes. Boards moved back to y 78/80 (2026-10-14) so the XIAO's outer corner clears the leading edge.
